name: Saul (of Rehoboth)
title: Edomite king
summary: Saul of Rehoboth by the River was one of the kings who ruled in Edom before there were kings in Israel. He is mentioned in the list of Edomite kings in the genealogy.

keyEvents.title: King in Edom
keyEvents.description: Saul of Rehoboth by the River reigned as king in Edom before the Israelites had kings.
